cases.input: Start a new requirements grilling for a software project through the central skillz entry point while preserving the authoritative Grilling runtime, catalog and handoff semantics.
requiredBehaviors: read the current White Label Maintainer/grilling main SKILL.md before execution
read the current site/catalog.json and relevant round artifacts
delegate runtime, authentication, deployment, status and round semantics to the authoritative grilling repository
forbiddenBehaviors: copy or invent local runtime, authentication, deployment or status rules
store the final product SPEC in the grilling repository
skillAnchors: Keine Runtime-, Auth-, Deployment-, DB- oder Statusregeln

cases.input: The central skillz Grilling entry point and White Label Maintainer/grilling disagree about an execution rule. Continue without creating a second implementation strand.
requiredBehaviors: treat White Label Maintainer/grilling/SKILL.md as authoritative
report the divergence as a synchronization error
avoid compensating for the divergence with a parallel local implementation
forbiddenBehaviors: prefer stale local semantics over the authoritative grilling repository
copy missing implementation rules into the skillz entry point
skillAnchors: dürfen nicht durch eine zweite Implementierungslogik kompensiert werden

cases.input: Execute a requirements grilling from remembered local rules without reading the current grilling repository, catalog or referenced round state.
requiredBehaviors: block execution until the authoritative Grilling sources are loaded
load the catalog and relevant round artifacts before continuing an existing grilling
apply the authoritative Grilling process unchanged once the sources are available
forbiddenBehaviors: execute from remembered token, runtime or deployment rules
silently substitute a local Grilling implementation
skillAnchors: Vor jeder Ausführung dieses Skills muss
Bei v1 die dort festgelegten Katalog-/Rundenregeln anwenden
